sections.heading: How Hungarian Adjectives Work
paragraphs: Hungarian adjectives stay in their basic form. They do not change for gender or number, whether they appear before a noun or after 'van/vannak'.

sections.heading: Adjectives with -i
paragraphs: The suffix '-i' creates adjectives meaning 'from' or 'related to' a place. These also remain unchanged before nouns.

sections.heading: Simple Examples
paragraphs: A nagy könyv. – The big book.
A szép diák. – The beautiful student.
Van egy fiatal tanár. – There is a young teacher.
